long_biography.plain_text:
Born to steel-mill workers in Cherepovets, Alexey Mordashov studied economics in Leningrad before returning home as an economist at the local works. He rose to finance director as the Soviet industrial system gave way to privatisation. Mordashov created investment funds that bought shares from employees, securing control of the newly reorganised Severstal. He later spent nineteen years as chief executive while expanding and modernising the steel group.

His later civic work grew from the same industrial community. Mordashov initiated the Way Home charitable foundation, which supports families in difficult circumstances, works to prevent family separation and juvenile offending, and helps talented children and teachers develop. The programme began in Cherepovets and expanded across other regions where Severstal operates.
